notes.title: DEVLOG 2 - More Content & Estimated Release Date!
notes.notes:
The hunting system has been completed and development is now focusing on adding content and systems that build on existing ones to make them more rewarding and interesting.

BADGE SYSTEM
One of the most important systems that have been introduced is the Badge System. The player will have a menu in which a series of badges associated with various tasks will be available. When the player reaches a goal, he will be rewarded with the unlocking of the badge, the possibility of framing it to place it on the wall to create his own "trophy room" and additional rewards depending on the badge unlocked. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/333caad3f124850ff60e74814c036dfb0df2739c.png

The tasks you will have to complete to unlock badges vary with various activities such as resource gathering, hunting, buying and selling and others such as "explorer badges" which you will earn by hiking through the beautiful valley and finding places of interest. 

Some of the rewards you will be able to obtain are framed badges, advanced tools, special decoration pieces or access to exclusive building locations.

In addition to in-game rewards, the player will receive a Steam Achievement associated with each Badge unlocked!

MORE CONTENT
Other systems have been added, such as the possibility of transporting objects with the car, a mechanic workshop where you can customize and improve your car, a tow truck to tow it in case you get stuck without gas in the middle of nowhere and... NPCs!

As for the NPCs, they will be mainly inhabiting the village. There will not be a deep system of relationships with them as that is not the objetive of the game, which is to live quietly away from society and build your own paradise in the mountains. 

The NPCs will offer services to the player, you will be able to have small chats with them, and they will give clues to the player about interesting locations in the game world or tips on game mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/b1273a4668f526c4afc769d66253efb83fc79684.png

There have also been added many interactions with the furniture and some surprises that you will discover at launch!

RELEASE DATE
Although it is still early to establish a concrete date as some elements such as steam achievements and localization could take longer than expected, the estimated release will be early in the second half of the year, around July or August.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43120184/808fbc0135568213495f1e9e1b35a2a45248f759.png

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist so you get notified as soon as it is released!

Greetings and happy gaming!

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.2b Hotfix
notes.notes:
The new update of Evergreen - Prologue contains more audio settings and an enhanced input customization to help players make the gameplay experience more suitable to them! 

Version v.0.1.2b

 The number of hits necessary to chop down a tree has been reduced.
 Fixed a bug of the new input system that made mouse sensitivity changes too abrupt.

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The new update of Evergreen - Prologue contains more audio settings and an enhanced input customization to help players make the gameplay experience more suitable to them! 

Version v.0.1.2

 Fixed translation typo in the inventory UI.
 Now the UI fully adapts itself for the custom input keys the player has chosen.
 Now you can close the inventory, map and building menus with your chosen input key in addition to the default 'Escape' key.
 The keybinding menu has been expanded to include more inputs.
 The keybinding menu now includes the option to remap car controls.
 The audio settings have been expanded. 
 Now the keybinding and audio configuration will be saved between different gaming sessions.

notes.title: Evergreen - Prologue v0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all who have played the prologue of Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator!
I hope that you enjoyed your first day in the valley!

Thank you all for leaving your feedback about the prologue, that help me make the final game the best it can be.

Version v.0.1.1

 Now the day starts when the sun is higher so you have more ambient lighting.
 Now you can hold the Left Mouse Button to collect resources.
 The base velocity of the car has been lightly increased.
 The intensity of the car lights has been increased.
 A *click* sound has been added when you turn on/off the car lights.
 The brake lights have been improved.
 A reposition button has been added to the car so you can press 'R' to relocate the car in case you get stuck.
 A Minimap has been added to the car UI.
